title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Count Basie Center for the Arts, Red Bank | 2022
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Count Basie Center for the Arts in Red Bank, New Jersey, USA, on 10 June 2022.

It was the tenth show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2022 tour of North America, which lasted for 30 dates between May and October 2022.

Starr had previously performed at the Count Basie Theatre, as the venue was then known, on 20 June 2014.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
